name: PetExpenses

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners sharing responsibility for a pet
setting.background: Routine pet costs are manageable, but future veterinary expenses are uncertain

scenario_template.topic: Reviewing routine pet expenses
scenario_template.note: They discuss food, grooming, supplies, and routine care

scenario_template.topic: Realizing unexpected pet costs could strain their budget
scenario_template.note: They want to be prepared without overestimating expenses

scenario_template.topic: Creating a dedicated pet savings category
scenario_template.note: They ask how to prepare for irregular costs

scenario_template.topic: Separating routine spending from future pet expenses
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them plan for predictable and uncertain costs

scenario_template.topic: Choosing a monthly contribution
scenario_template.note: They compare pet savings with other household priorities

scenario_template.topic: Handling a month with unusually high pet costs
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them decide how to replenish the fund afterward

scenario_template.topic: Establishing a dedicated pet expense fund
scenario_template.note: They feel better prepared for future responsibilities

scenario_template.topic: Reevaluating pet care routines

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
